Macaroni Pizza
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




8 ounces your favorite pasta
1 to 2 eggs, depending on size
spaghetti sauce or pizza sauce, to tas
cheese, to taste
Other pizza ingredients as you favor

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees 2 Cook pizza according to package direction. Drain and rinse in cold water. 3 Place the eggs in a bowl and mix them. Add drained, rinsed pasta. Place in a buttered 8 or 9 inch square pan. Cook in oven for 10 minutes. 4 Remove from oven, add sauce and any other pizza toppings. Cover with cheese. Place back in oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbling and brown. 5 Remove from oven and let stand for 5-10 minutes to let pizza set before cutting.

About


This was originally a vegetarian recipe, but if you use meat, onions, peppers, etc., pre-cook them before adding them to the pizza. Recipe from Gail Goodwin.
